retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast monochrome portrait framed by a wide off-white border with a single line of elegant serif text and a vibrant orange circular accent.
triggerTerms: serif text with orange circle accent
excludeWhen: modern sans-serif minimalist layouts are requested
busy or complex background textures are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring a large, grainy black-and-white close-up portrait of a man. The image is inset within a wide, cream-colored border. At the top, a single line of italicized serif text is split by a solid orange sun-like circle, creating a focal point of color against the desaturated palette.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochrome subject vs. cream-colored negative space
Small vibrant orange circle vs. large desaturated portrait
Delicate italicized typography vs. heavy photographic grain
Top-aligned text vs. centered square image
coreInvariants: The orange circle must be the only saturated color element.
The portrait must be high-contrast monochrome with visible film grain.
A wide, uniform off-white or cream border must surround the central image.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The portrait is a tight headshot, centered horizontally and vertically within the inner frame, occupying approximately 70% of the total area.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The orange circle at the top center acts as the primary visual anchor and color pop.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the orange circle, moves left and right to read the text, then drops down into the eyes of the portrait.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial off-white border provides breathing room and a vintage 'matted' feel.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in the border vs. image; low saturation overall except for the single high-saturation accent.
paletteRestrictions: No other colors besides orange, black, white, and cream.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for both name and title to maintain 1970s folk simplicity.
graphicDevices: Solid orange circle placed between text segments

candidateDirections.reason: Classic old-style serif with appropriate 70s editorial feel.
Elegant, readable, and fits the folk-revival aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square monochrome portrait of a man with 1970s hair, high contrast and film grain, inset within a wide cream-colored border. Leave the top margin clear.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of small italic serif text in the top margin, split in the middle by a solid orange circle.

verificationChecks: Is the orange circle the only saturated color?
Is the text in an italicized serif font?
Is there a wide cream border around the image?

mustRedesign: Avoid using modern digital-clean photography; must have grain.
postGenerationChecks: Check for film grain texture in the portrait.
Ensure the orange circle is perfectly circular and solid.
Verify the text is small and elegant, not overpowering.
Confirm the cream border is uniform on all sides.
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochrome Grainy Portrait + Wide Cream Border + Italic Serif + Orange Circle Accent
